Welcome to VitalCore
Your health data stays on this phone. VitalCore has no account, no server and no internet permission — every score is computed on the device from data you already have in Health Connect.
Connect Health Connect
VitalCore reads sleep, heart rate, steps and workouts. You can grant some and refuse others; anything you refuse is simply left out, and the confidence badge will say so.
What are you training for?
This nudges the workout recommendation. It never overrides a recovery signal.
Pair your watch
Open your watch\'s companion app — Samsung Health, Google Fit, Fitbit or Garmin Connect — and turn on syncing to Health Connect. VitalCore reads whatever lands there.
Daily check-in
Ten seconds each morning on energy, stress and soreness. It is optional, and it measurably sharpens the recommendation because no sensor can see how you feel.
Learning your normal
Every score is relative to you, not to a population average. That takes 14–30 days to settle. Until then scores are shown with lower confidence rather than hidden.
Your coach
The coach answers from a rules engine running on this device. Nothing you record is sent anywhere. If a cloud model is ever offered, it will be opt-in and you will be asked first.
Notifications
A morning summary when your scores are ready, and a check-in reminder. Both are optional and can be changed later in Settings.
You\'re set
Scores appear after the first sync. Triple-tap the title on Home in a debug build to open the developer screen.
